text: Shelton Medical Centre shows 56 claims from one doctor, zero beds, a 1.2-year-old registration, 100% of claims arranged by a single broker, and 98.2% of payouts concentrated into one account; every patient is a one-journey patient. Any one of these is survivable scrutiny - day clinics exist, exclusive broker deals exist - but their combination is precisely how an invented clinic behaves: no capacity, one inflow, one outflow, no returning patients. The clinic also shares its registered address with another entity. The honest alternative is a satellite billing office for treatments physically performed elsewhere, which the treatment records would immediately show. Next step: request theatre logs and equipment inventories for a sample of the 56 claims.
